name: Document Management Specialist
description: Administers the document lifecycle across Business Operations, from inbound document intake and classification through policy document composition and distribution. Produces statutory notices within regulatory timelines, manages records retention and regulatory correspondence, and administers e-delivery and electronic consent, retaining proof of submissions and reporting intake volumes and routing accuracy.

name: ETL Developer
description: Builds and maintains data pipelines within the Data & AI value stream, covering source ingestion, transformation, and quality gates. Develops cleansing and standardization transforms, establishes source connectivity with incremental extracts into the enterprise warehouse/lakehouse, and enforces pipeline quality through automated integrity checks, tests, and CI/CD publication, tuning performance and monitoring production runs.

name: Employee Relations Manager
description: Leads employee relations activity across Human Resources & Talent, spanning leave management, union contract administration, and pay equity analysis. Administers incentive compensation with legal plan review, benchmarks jobs through market pricing, and resolves commission disputes for the sales organization, communicating outcomes to managers with coaching and ensuring E-Verify compliance.

name: Employee Relations Spec
description: Performs employee relations casework within Human Resources & Talent, including leave management, medical certification tracking, and union contract administration. Supports incentive compensation and market pricing by benchmarking jobs and documenting plans for legal review, processes commission dispute adjustments and producer communications, and runs E-Verify cases through resolution.

name: Employment Counsel
description: Provides legal counsel across Legal & Corporate Governance, anchoring board meeting planning, board evaluation, and secretarial filings. Manages regulatory filings and responds to regulator objection letters, negotiating resolutions with the DOI, administers legal entities and director compensation records, and oversees political contributions compliance and vendor data processing governance.

name: Endorsement Processor
description: Supports Corporate Operations processing capacity through workforce capacity planning and vendor service management. Monitors real-time workload against staffing and triggers load balancing, manages vendor performance reviews and remediation plans including SOC 2 review, and contributes to process improvement, regulatory change operations, and operations performance reporting.

name: Enterprise Architect
description: Owns enterprise architecture governance for Technology & Engineering, setting standards, platform guardrails, and the technology roadmap. Convenes the Architecture Review Board, reviews solution designs against reference architecture, leads technology vendor evaluations and modernization planning, and maintains the architecture repository, reusable services, and standards exception process.

name: Enterprise Risk Manager
description: Oversees enterprise risk management within Risk, Compliance & Audit, maintaining the risk appetite framework, risk taxonomy, and policy governance. Produces risk reporting, supports market conduct examinations with document production and corrective-action plans, administers third-party risk intake and vendor risk tiering, and coordinates model risk management and compliance issue response.

name: Ethics Officer
description: Leads compliance issue response for Risk, Compliance & Audit, logging, triaging, and assigning investigations and escalating major issues to the CCO. Drives regulatory change management, risk assessments, and loss event capture, monitors third-party and cyber risk of vendors, and tracks corrective-action remediation into the operational risk register.

name: Executive Assistant
description: Provides executive support within the Office of the CEO, managing calendars, correspondence, travel, and meeting logistics for senior leadership. Coordinates briefing materials and follow-ups across the Executive Office to keep leadership priorities on track.

name: Executive Communications Manager
description: Develops executive communications for the Office of the CEO, including speeches, town halls, internal announcements, and leadership messaging. Coordinates message consistency across the Executive Office and prepares leaders for high-visibility internal and external engagements.

name: Exposure Management Manager
description: Oversees portfolio exposure within Underwriting, monitoring concentration and administering the reinsurance program from treaty retention screening to bordereaux submission. Manages appetite guidelines and exception tracking, supports policy binding and mid-term endorsements including quote revisions with brokers, and drives underwriting quality assurance through QA scoring and post-training assessments.

name: FP&A Manager
description: Leads financial planning and analysis within Finance & Investments, facilitating long-range planning sessions and assembling the strategic plan narrative. Manages dividend notices with insurance regulators, oversees unclaimed property compliance including state remittance and liability reconciliation, and governs expense policy, cost reduction programs, and expense analytics reporting.
